ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65:35 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white regions occupy the majority of the lateral lobes. These are bisected by a central black pigmentation zone extending from the peduncle. Discrete black pixel clusters and linear streaks are mapped within the white regions, most notably a series of dark marks on the lower left lobe and isolated punctate spots on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 60-70 degrees; the notch depth extends approximately 12% into the vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks are dominant, with higher-amplitude, jagged 'valleys' or notches localized on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a sharp transition at the tips; trailing edges exhibit a moderate concave curve sweeping toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters, indicative of barnacle colonization, are densely mapped on the dark-pigmented distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected on the white pigmentation of both lobes; specifically, three distinct diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe and thin horizontal streaks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or heavy scarring on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe, creating a ragged, high-amplitude topography compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated white pixel cluster is visible within the dark central region just above the peduncle junction.
